items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Mingus played with the band for a little while and I showed him too.

ctx.x: Mingus played with the band for a little while and I showed him too. Mingus never forgot me, you know. Right to this day he would say I was the only one that showed him anything, you know.

items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And the trombone player was Butter, wasn't it?

ctx.x: Dick Hafer, yeah. He didn't play M. BASS CLARINET. any solos, he just had to play parts, mostly. And, boy, that was -- that just blew me away. And the trombone player was Butter, wasn't it? [Quentin JACKSON ed. note]
